title: cli: `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` should carry a form withdrawal onto a read-only packages view through its `.custom` pair, declared, instead of stopping
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the contract review of PR #29270 (#28905), record 6577747588, should-fix S4 (the dev's open question 2, answered A).

Since #28905, `carryFormWithdrawals` (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts`) stops with a fail-closed blocker when it saves a withdrawal onto a view that a read-only package ships. The save names `servedPackageOf(served)`, which the door now refuses, and the blocker quotes the door's message. That is safe, and the changeset tells the operator the manual step.

Ask: when the served package is read-only and its pair can be ensured, the carry saves into the pair, declaring `overrides` on the base (the helpers `ensurePair` / `declaredOverride` show the shape in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/customization-pair.ts`). Otherwise it keeps the blocker. Pins with a read-only package's view and a writable one.
